wiki_items.title: System Overview
wiki_items.description: Product overview: two implementations of one SSH tunnel domain, runtime topology, fronts, transports, persistent state, lifecycle and error model.

wiki_items.title: Architecture
wiki_items.description: Ports-and-adapters design shared by the Rust and TypeScript managers, transport selection, adoption, timing constants, security boundaries and design tensions.

wiki_items.title: Monorepo Layout
wiki_items.description: pnpm/Turborepo workspace plus three Cargo workspaces, package roles, dependency edges, source-direct libraries and bundled artifacts.

wiki_items.title: Boundaries and Drift
wiki_items.description: What check-boundaries actually enforces, where AGENTS.md and README diverge from the code, and verified Rust/TypeScript behavioural drift.

wiki_items.title: Rust Tunnel Core
wiki_items.description: crates/tunnel-core: contract, errors, state machine, validation, argv builder, ports, OS host implementations and the blocking manager.

wiki_items.title: TypeScript Service Layer
wiki_items.description: packages/ssh-service: TunnelManager lifecycle, persistence semantics, the 19-endpoint Hono API, and the daemon launcher.

wiki_items.title: Contract
wiki_items.description: packages/ssh-contract: zod profile/state schemas, closed problem codes, HTTP status map, response envelopes and route table.

wiki_items.title: Core Logic
wiki_items.description: packages/ssh-core: ssh argv building, endpoint derivation, semantic validation and the lifecycle state machine.

wiki_items.title: Typed Client
wiki_items.description: packages/ssh-client: fetch client, Tauri invoke client, response validation, error mapping and the full HTTP/IPC command map.

wiki_items.title: Node Host
wiki_items.description: packages/ssh-host-node: process supervision, TCP probing, atomic profile store, runtime records, control sockets, PATH lookup, ssh config, terminals and URL opening.

wiki_items.title: Web UI Kit
wiki_items.description: packages/web-ui: shadcn-svelte components, platform-variant tokens and the shell geometry shared by every console host.

wiki_items.title: Build Helper
wiki_items.description: packages/build-helper: shared esbuild bundling, TUI externals, production defines and per-package build scripts.

wiki_items.title: Desktop App
wiki_items.description: apps/desktop: Tauri 2 shell linking tunnel-core in-process, 19 IPC commands, window material on macOS/Windows, configuration, build and WebDriver e2e.

wiki_items.title: Web Console
wiki_items.description: apps/web: static SvelteKit SPA, transport selection, polling, tunnel rows, editor, log sheet, appearance and test hooks.

wiki_items.title: CLI
wiki_items.description: apps/cli: daemon/direct modes, command set, output and error behaviour, direct-mode capability limits and help-text drift.

wiki_items.title: TUI
wiki_items.description: apps/tui: OpenTUI/React fullscreen console, keyboard map, pure list view, creation form, bundling and test layers.

wiki_items.title: Server Daemon
wiki_items.description: apps/server: composition-only daemon binary, flags, startup sequence, static Web UI serving, discovery file and operational limits.

wiki_items.title: DSH Plugin
wiki_items.description: integrations/dsh: in-process Hono workbench mounted on the DeepSeek Harness server, loopback guards and the framed panel.

wiki_items.title: VS Code Extension
wiki_items.description: integrations/vscode: daemon supervisor, sidebar tree, commands, workbench webview, packaging and tests.

wiki_items.title: Build and Release
wiki_items.description: Local scripts, Turbo graph, CI jobs, tag-driven multi-platform release, version stamping, artifact naming and signing reality.

wiki_items.title: Testing and Fixtures
wiki_items.description: Vitest configurations, suite map, cross-language golden fixtures, Rust gates, desktop e2e and what CI actually runs.
